criteria.description: POST /llm/routes and POST /llm/routes/{routeId}/releases are not mounted; LLM GET routes and PUT /llm/routes/{id} are not intentionally removed.
POST /adoption/scan and POST /adoption/import are not mounted even when adoption is enabled.
POST /services/{serviceId}/environments/{envId}/deploy, restart, and stop are not mounted even when direct runtime actions are enabled.
Deleted HTTP handler methods are no longer callable from routes, while helper mapping/error behavior retained in remaining files compiles and is tested.
Client SDK helpers for removed adoption/direct-runtime REST mutations fail before network access and guide callers to signed Nostr events.
Documentation and the REST deprecation plan reflect the final removal and signer-first replacements.
